nota: Textos del piso ATLAS (atlas-piso.js). Las cifras NO van aqui: las formatea el navegador con Intl.NumberFormat en la lengua de la pagina.

ui.lema: The Sunken Forest. Atlantis did not sink: it fell asleep. You wake it.
ui.sello: UNSAVED · the Forest lives in this tab
ui.flujo_t: Volatile data in the pipes: it evaporates if unused
ui.alerta_p: Cold water is pouring into the outer ruins. Every cycle left unrepaired takes integrity from the Core.
ui.mapa_nota: The fog covers what no Atlantean has explored yet.
ui.dormias_nota: Sleep counts for up to 24 h. After that, the forest waits.
ui.nucleo_p: {a} XP · the sum of your seven crafts
ui.nucleo_nota: The laws of this world come from real measurements of this site: {pruebas} tests passing, {lenguas} languages, {kb} KB of game per visit.
ui.pie: No server and no network: everything happens in this tab and is lost when you close it. Closing theGame does not erase it.
ui.dlg_l1: You're awake. Good: the forest was starting to forget your name.
ui.dlg_l2: The rift at 120 m is letting cold water into the outer ruins. Every cycle it stays open, the Core loses integrity.
ui.dlg_l3: Take the Forge's copper plates down with you. Seal it, and the whole village breathes easier.
ui.atlas_retrato_alt: Pixel-art portrait of the Preceptor: a marble bust with half its face in copper and one eye glowing violet; on alert, the eye burns copper.
ui.mundo_nd: NO_DATA · the laws of the world did not arrive: the Forest uses neutral ones.
ui.fase_fin: Final phase reached: the Core is sovereign.
ui.falta_cobre: {n} copper short: the Forge has not produced enough yet.
ui.b4n_no: The Core stays closed: more Engineering is needed.
ui.dormias_vacio: Nothing yet: the Forest produces while this tab is hidden, up to 24 h.
ui.ascenso: Out of oxygen: emergency ascent to the reef.
ui.casa_mal: The Core suffers when the house is unwell: the site's harness is not whole or the game is too heavy, and the rift does double damage.
ui.cierre_aviso: Your game stays in this tab until you close it: theGame saves nothing.
